question: Which of the following institutes was founded by MG Ranade and GV Joshi?
solution:
The correct answer is **Poona Sarvajanik Sabha**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Poona Sarvajanik Sabha** was founded by **MG Ranade and GV Joshi**.
 
• It was established to serve as a platform for civic and political dialogue in Pune.
 
• The organization played a significant role in the early stages of the Indian freedom movement.
 
• It aimed at educating the public on their rights and duties and acted as a bridge between the people and the British government.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 1) Abhinav Bharat
 A secret society formed by Vinayak Damodar Savarkar in 1904 aimed at India's independence through revolution.
 
 

 2) The Indian National Congress
 Founded in 1885 by Allan Octavian Hume, Dadabhai Naoroji, and Dinshaw Wacha, it was the first modern nationalist movement to emerge in the British Empire in Asia and Africa.
 
 

 3) The Bombay Presidency Association
 Formed in 1885 by Ferozeshah Mehta, Badruddin Tyabji, and KT Telang, it aimed at political reforms and representation of Indian interests.
